description: Every path, including /robots.txt, answers 403 with a Cloudflare-style managed-challenge body and Cloudflare-style headers (Server: cloudflare, cf-ray, cf-mitigated: challenge). Nothing behind the wall is ever served, so nothing is extractable.

pages.every_path: 403 + challenge.html (__HOST__ replaced with the request Host header)

response_headers.Cache-Control: private, max-age=0, no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, post-check=0, pre-check=0

notes: The challenge script tag points at a relative /cdn-cgi/... path, so a browser loading the page only ever asks the fixture server (which answers 403 again).
The orchestrate path is chl_page (current Cloudflare form), not the captcha/managed/jsch forms that cloudscraper 1.2.71 recognises as a v2 challenge.
